decisions.reason: As a two-component resin injection unit, it is very close to the firm's established coating and application know-how, so management is likely to keep it and use early market feedback to refine it rather than withdraw it quickly.

This product also builds directly on the firm's existing mechanical and application knowledge, although overlap with another resin injection unit gives it a slightly higher rationalisation risk if the variants prove too similar.
An automatic airless spray gun fits strongly with the firm's core technical base in spraying equipment, making it a product the firm is well positioned to improve and support commercially.
A manual airless spray gun is closely related to established product and market knowledge, so even if initial uptake is uneven the firm would usually keep it long enough to learn and adjust.
The air-assisted airless spray gun is an adjacent variant within the firm's main competence area, which lowers uncertainty and makes continued development more likely than withdrawal.

The data logger is complementary to the firm's coating equipment and strategically useful, but its stronger digital content makes it somewhat more likely to be dropped if the firm cannot absorb and commercialise the needed software-electronics capabilities fast enough.
